title: FlagEmbedding BGE-M3 model implementation
scope: The inspected implementation creates sparse_linear as Linear(hidden_size, 1), applies ReLU to per-token scalar weights, and aggregates by input_ids into vocabulary coordinates using max/scatter-reduce.
transfer_limits: This source establishes the architecture mechanism at this code revision, not whether a specific BAAI/bge-m3 checkpoint contains trained weights.
It does not validate historical ONNX exports, their tensor shapes, or any reported CPU timings.
It is not evidence that BGE-M3 should be the default model or is qualified for the Maestria launcher.
use_in_erratum: Primary mechanism for correcting the [1,1024] shape inference; no weights were downloaded.

title: BGE-M3 documentation in FlagEmbedding
scope: Official documentation describes sparse token weights as a linear layer followed by ReLU and lexical scoring by shared-token weights.
transfer_limits: Documentation is explanatory material, not a checkpoint inspection or independent model evaluation.
It does not establish the trained state of a released weight file, the behavior of an export, or suitability as a launcher default.
use_in_erratum: Corroborating official description only; the exact projection shape and aggregation behavior are grounded in the pinned implementation source.
